pairs.prompt_text:
Very thorough exploration of the sovereignty-related code in this ESI.ts project. I need to understand the full pattern for how endpoints are defined, clients are built, and types are structured.

Search for and read these files completely:
1. `src/core/endpoints/sovereigntyEndpoints.ts` — endpoint definitions
2. `src/clients/SovereigntyClient.ts` — client class
3. `src/types/sovereignty.ts` — type definitions
4. Any sovereignty test files (search in `tests/` directory for sovereignty)
5. Any sovereignty examples (search in `examples/` for sovereignty)

For each file, report:
- The full file content
- The pattern used (how endpoints are defined, how the client wraps them, how types map to responses)
- Any imports and how they connect the pieces together

Also check how the sovereignty client is exported/registered — look at `src/clients/index.ts` or `src/index.ts` to see how clients are made available.
